mapper.sql: p.person_id personId,p.person_no personNo,p.person_type personType,p.real_name realName, p.dept_id deptId,d.dept_name deptName,p.user_id userId,u.user_name userName,p.status, p.remark,p.create_time createTime, CASE WHEN p.status='1' OR u.status='1' OR u.del_flag='2' THEN 'DISABLED' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ca_wx_binding w WHERE w.user_id=p.user_id AND w.status='0') THEN 'BOUND' ELSE 'UNBOUND' END bindingState
FROM ca_person p LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=p.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=p.user_id

sql.if: AND (p.person_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

mapper.select: SELECT WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY p.person_id DESC

SELECT ,b.binding_id bindingId,b.appid,b.status bindingStatus, b.bind_time bindTime,b.last_login_time lastLoginTime LEFT JOIN ca_wx_binding b ON b.user_id=p.user_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY p.person_id DESC,b.binding_id
